constraint.description: Assessment / Grid / Supplier ModuleApi interfaces must not live in core.application.moduleapi (each module owns its API).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND t.fqn =~ '.*\\.core\\.application\\.moduleapi\\.(Assessment|Grid|Supplier)[A-Za-z]*ModuleApi' RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'module API declared in core' AS Detail

constraint.description: Module dependencies must be listed in the parameter allowedModuleDependencies ('a->b;c->d'). Empty parameter = rule disabled (D07 matrix to confirm).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Module)-[d:DEPENDS_ON_MODULE]->(b:Module) WHERE $allowedModuleDependencies <> '' AND NOT (a.name + '->' + b.name) IN [x IN split($allowedModuleDependencies, ';') | trim(x)] RETURN a AS Element, a.fqn AS Fqn, a.name + ' -> ' + b.name + ' (weight ' + toString(d.weight) + ')' AS Detail

MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE NOT t:Test AND m.fullPath ENDS WITH '/feign/assessments/acl/batchCreate' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, m.httpMethod + ' ' + m.fullPath AS Detail

constraint.description: Maintenance code (MigrateController, TestService, /temp/** endpoints) must not ship to production.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (t.name IN ['MigrateController', 'TestService'] OR EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method:Endpoint) WHERE m.fullPath CONTAINS '/temp/' }) RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'maintenance code in production artifact' AS Detail

constraint.description: Any dependency on org.mozilla.javascript (Rhino) is forbidden (script injection).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(x:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND x.fqn STARTS WITH 'org.mozilla.javascript.' RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, x.fqn AS Detail

constraint.description: AuthService redirect validation must not use String#startsWith.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type {name: 'AuthService'})-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(:Type {fqn: 'java.lang.String'}) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'startsWith' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'String#startsWith in redirect validation' AS Detail

constraint.description: TokenAuthFilter must not log the query string (tokens).
GexListener consumers must reach the processed-message store.
KafkaTemplate#send is only allowed from the producers matching allowedKafkaProducerRegex (D05: GEX and PDF/Document boundaries only).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(send:Method:BrokerSend) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT t.fqn =~ $allowedKafkaProducerRegex RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, send.signature AS Detail
